questions.question: What is the life expectancy at birth for California's total population in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_california_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='CA total population', header=None)
age_col = df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str)
row_idx = df[age_col.str.contains(r'^0[–\-]1', regex=True)].index[0]
result = float(df.iloc[row_idx, 6])

questions.question: Between the 20–21 and 30–31 age groups, which experienced a higher number of deaths out of the life table cohort?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_california_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='CA total population', header=None)
age_col = df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str)
row_20 = df[age_col.str.contains(r'^20[–\-]21', regex=True)].index[0]
row_30 = df[age_col.str.contains(r'^30[–\-]31', regex=True)].index[0]
dx_20 = float(df.iloc[row_20, 3])
dx_30 = float(df.iloc[row_30, 3])
result = df.iloc[row_30, 0] if dx_30 > dx_20 else df.iloc[row_20, 0]

questions.question: How many age intervals have an annual mortality probability of at least 10%?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_california_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='CA total population', header=None)
data = df.iloc[3:104].copy()
qx = pd.to_numeric(data.iloc[:, 1], errors='coerce')
result = int((qx >= 0.10).sum())

questions.question: Does more than half of the initial 100,000 synthetic birth cohort survive to reach age 80?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_california_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='CA total population', header=None)
age_col = df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str)
row_80 = df[age_col.str.contains(r'^80[–\-]81', regex=True)].index[0]
lx_80 = float(df.iloc[row_80, 2])
result = 'yes' if lx_80 > 50000 else 'no'

questions.question: Which three age brackets record the highest number of deaths in the life table?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
import json

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_california_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='CA total population', header=None)
data = df.iloc[3:104].copy()
data['age'] = data.iloc[:, 0]
data['dx'] = pd.to_numeric(data.iloc[:, 3], errors='coerce')
top3 = data.nlargest(3, 'dx')['age'].tolist()
